verdict.rationale: Prompt/prefix caching is a fair question for an LLM inference API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents caching of repeated context. Batch discounts, flex/service tiers and raw token speed are adjacent cost and latency features, not prefix caching, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context
